text: Today, we’re releasing v0 of The Guild Genesis — a peer-run network where developers earn reputation through real contributions. Think: attestations from peers, skill badges, and a transparent, portable profile you control.
Reference links: The Guild — Presentation, and The Guild — The Plan.
Profiles: Create a profile tied to your wallet; it’s your public developer card.
Attestations: Peers recognize specific contributions; these are stored and displayed.
Badges: Create badges (skills/achievements) and award them to others.
Activity Token (TGA): A non-monetary token that reflects on-chain activity; it will later power governance (voting).
Install MetaMask and add Polygon Amoy. Download MetaMask and add the network via Chainlist (Chain ID 80002).
Get Amoy testnet gas by asking in the Discord; a member will send a small amount of MATIC.
Create your Guild profile at theguild.dev by connecting your wallet and setting up your public developer card.
Propose and create a skill badge on the Badges page — for example Rust, React, or Security.

section: Getting started: give someone a badge
text: After collaborating, issue a badge attestation to recognize another developer’s contribution. This builds portable, credible profiles and grows the network.
A lightweight Getting Started page inside the app provides the exact steps, links, and navigation paths for new members.
We’re building The Guild in public. Contributions are recognized on-chain through attestations and badges, and rewarded with non-monetary TGA points that grant future voting rights.
Join the Discord, create your profile, add your Discord username, discuss scope for a ticket, then submit your PR. Merges occur once acceptance criteria are met.
Rule of thumb: 10 points/hour, 80 points/day. Tokens have no monetary value; they grant governance rights. Contributors also receive profile badges for meaningful work.

We’ve wired up CI/CD to Heroku (container registry) for backend and frontend. Public frontend environment variables are baked at build time. The app uses attestations and badges to turn contributions into portable, credible signals.
Try v0 at theguild.dev. Introduce yourself in Discord. Pick a ticket and help shape how developers build reputation together.
